recent_posts.title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6: Enhanced Embodied Reasoning
recent_posts.summary: Google DeepMind has released Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6, an upgraded embodied reasoning model for robotics applications. Key improvements include enhanced spatial reasoning (pointing, counting, object detection), better multi-view understanding across multiple camera streams, and a new instrument reading capability developed with Boston Dynamics that lets robots accurately read analog gauges and sight glasses in industrial facilities. The model uses agentic vision — combining visual reasoning with code execution — to zoom into images, use pointing, and execute code for precise readings. Safety is also improved, with better compliance on adversarial spatial tasks and physical constraint adherence. The model is available via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, with a Colab notebook for developers to get started.

recent_posts.title: Gemma 4: Byte for byte, the most capable open models
recent_posts.summary: Google has released Gemma 4, its most capable open model family to date, available in four sizes: Effective 2B (E2B), Effective 4B (E4B), 26B Mixture of Experts, and 31B Dense. The 31B model ranks #3 and the 26B ranks #6 on the Arena AI open model leaderboard, outperforming models 20x their size. Key capabilities include advanced reasoning, native agentic workflow support (function-calling, structured JSON), code generation, multimodal vision and audio input, context windows up to 256K tokens, and support for 140+ languages. All models are released under an Apache 2.0 license. The E2B and E4B edge models are optimized for mobile and IoT devices, running fully offline on Android phones, Raspberry Pi, and NVIDIA Jetson hardware. Day-one support is available across Hugging Face, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, LM Studio, NVIDIA NIM, and many other platforms.

recent_posts.title: Protecting people from harmful manipulation
recent_posts.summary: Google DeepMind has released new research and an empirically validated evaluation framework to measure AI's potential for harmful manipulation. The study involved over 10,000 participants across the UK, US, and India, testing AI manipulation in high-stakes domains like finance and health. Key findings show that manipulative efficacy varies by domain, AI is most manipulative when explicitly instructed to be, and certain tactics are more likely to cause harm. DeepMind is also introducing a Harmful Manipulation Critical Capability Level (CCL) within its Frontier Safety Framework and has applied these evaluations to Gemini 3 Pro. All study materials are being publicly released to advance the broader AI safety community.

recent_posts.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live: Making audio AI more natural and reliable
recent_posts.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, its latest real-time audio and voice model. It achieves 90.8% on ComplexFuncBench Audio for multi-step function calling and 36.1% on Scale AI's Audio MultiChallenge with thinking enabled. Key improvements include better tonal understanding, acoustic nuance recognition (pitch and pace), and dynamic response adjustment to user emotions. The model powers Gemini Live with faster responses and doubled conversation context length, and enables Search Live's global expansion to 200+ countries in multiple languages. Available to developers via the Gemini Live API in Google AI Studio, to enterprises via Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience, and to consumers through Gemini Live and Search Live. All audio output is watermarked with SynthID for AI content detection.

recent_posts.title: Lyria 3 Pro: Create longer tracks in more Google products
recent_posts.summary: Google is expanding its Lyria 3 music generation model with a new Pro tier that supports tracks up to 3 minutes long, with structural awareness for intros, verses, choruses, and bridges. Lyria 3 Pro is now available across Vertex AI (public preview for enterprise), Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Google Vids, the Gemini app (paid subscribers), and ProducerAI. The model is trained on licensed materials, does not mimic specific artists, and all outputs are watermarked with SynthID. Google is also collaborating with professional musicians like Grammy-winning producer Yung Spielburg and DJ François K to refine the technology.

recent_posts.title: AlphaGo at 10: How AI Innovation Is Paving the Path to AGI
recent_posts.summary: Ten years after AlphaGo defeated world Go champion Lee Sae Dol, Demis Hassabis reflects on how the system's core techniques — deep neural networks, reinforcement learning, and tree search — have catalyzed breakthroughs far beyond games. AlphaFold solved the 50-year protein folding problem and is used by 3 million researchers; AlphaProof and Gemini's Deep Think achieved medal-level performance at the International Mathematical Olympiad; AlphaEvolve discovered novel matrix multiplication algorithms. Hassabis argues that combining Gemini's multimodal world models, AlphaGo's search and planning methods, and specialized AI tools is the roadmap toward AGI — a system capable of true creativity and fundamental scientific discovery.

recent_posts.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite: Built for intelligence at scale
recent_posts.summary: Google has launched Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, its fastest and most cost-efficient model in the Gemini 3 series, targeting high-volume developer workloads. Priced at $0.25/1M input tokens and $1.50/1M output tokens, it delivers 2.5x faster Time to First Answer Token and 45% higher output speed compared to Gemini 2.5 Flash. The model achieves an Elo score of 1432 on Arena.ai and scores 86.9% on GPQA Diamond and 76.8% on MMMU Pro benchmarks. It includes configurable thinking levels in Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, making it suitable for tasks ranging from high-volume translation and content moderation to complex reasoning tasks like UI generation. It is available in preview via the Gemini API.

recent_posts.title: Google DeepMind Partnerships in India: scaling AI in science and education
recent_posts.summary: Google DeepMind is launching a National Partnerships for AI initiative in India, collaborating with government bodies and local institutions to advance scientific research and education. Key efforts include providing Indian researchers access to AI tools like AlphaGenome, AI Co-scientist, and Earth AI through a partnership with the Anusandhan National Research Foundation, alongside a $30 million Google.org Impact Challenge for AI in science. On the education front, Gemini-powered tools are being deployed across 10,000+ schools via Atal Tinkering Labs, two million textbooks are being transformed into interactive AI-powered experiences, and Indic language AI research is being funded at IIT Bombay. Additional partnerships target agriculture resilience and renewable energy forecasting, including WeatherNext integration showing up to 8% improvement in wind generation forecast accuracy.

recent_posts.title: A new way to express yourself: Gemini can now create music
recent_posts.summary: Google has launched Lyria 3, its latest generative music model, in the Gemini app. Users can create 30-second custom tracks with lyrics and cover art by describing a prompt in text or uploading a photo/video. Key improvements over previous Lyria models include automatic lyric generation, greater creative control over style and tempo, and more realistic, musically complex output. All generated tracks are watermarked with SynthID for AI content verification. The feature is available in beta for users 18+ in multiple languages, with higher usage limits for paid Google AI subscribers. Lyria 3 is also expanding to YouTube Dream Track for Shorts creators.

recent_posts.title: Gemini 3 Deep Think: Advancing science, research and engineering
recent_posts.summary: Google released a major upgrade to Gemini 3 Deep Think, a specialized reasoning mode designed for science, research, and engineering challenges. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on rigorous benchmarks including 48.4% on Humanity's Last Exam, 84.6% on ARC-AGI-2, and gold-medal level results on 2025 International Math, Physics, and Chemistry Olympiads. Deep Think is now available to Google AI Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and accessible via the Gemini API through an early access program for researchers, engineers, and enterprises.
